id: title:frankh:load spans and show missing parent spans for orphan traces

review.posthog_relevance: Adds missing-parent span handling and UI notices to TraceWaterfallView and TraceDrawer, allowing the frontend to display and contextualize orphaned spans without crashing or omitting data.
